description: This source file implements the Monitor plugin's core functionality, including registration of API endpoints, handling restart limits, resetting statistics, fetching status, and signaling actions. It interfaces with JSON data structures and manages monitor-related operations within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A class providing monitoring functionalities such as restart limits, statistics reset, and status reporting within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: void RegisterAll()
methods.description: Registers all API endpoints and properties for the Monitor plugin.

methods.name: void UnregisterAll()
methods.description: Unregisters all API endpoints and properties for the Monitor plugin.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_restartlimits(const RestartlimitsParamsData & params)
methods.description: Handles setting new restart limits for a specified plugin.

methods.name: uint32_t endpoint_resetstats(const ResetstatsParamsData & params,InfoInfo & response)
methods.description: Resets stats for a specified plugin and populates the response with current info.

methods.name: uint32_t get_status(const string & index,Core::JSON::ArrayType<InfoInfo> & response) const
methods.description: Retrieves the current status (memory, process statistics) for a plugin or all monitored plugins.

methods.name: void event_action(const string & callsign,const string & action,const string & reason)
methods.description: Sends an action event indicating a specific action taken by the monitor for a plugin.
